# Three.js r187 runtime subset

Unmodified MIT-licensed upstream files from official three@0.187.0, git commit `7e89746a687bb88271253698fa108b1dd59825d0`. The restricted packaging manifest exposes the renderer and OrbitControls only. Vite minifies the production bundle; upstream no longer provides minified modules. Four file hashes are pinned by verify:vendor. No Minecraft textures included.

Upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/7e89746a687bb88271253698fa108b1dd59825d0
